author: Norr14
body:
First question off the bat is, do you have Buggane summon? And on that same note Very scary Skeleton? Those two summons alone, especially the Buggane imo, skyrocket your damage a great deal when it comes to bosses or raids. They have a multi attack that has a good chance to crit. VSS are not bad themselves in their damage output and also more reliably apply T. Double Def down, so pairing one or two with a squad of Bugganes is a great strategy.

I believe Bugganes may be available for purchase rn during the Wyrmsong event from the Monumental Guild or an Arcanist if ur lucky as I have been seeing them as enemies. Try to be on the lookout for that and check the guild.

Second question, what is your gear looking like in terms of your hp and ward. Many people say to try to push upwards of 10k ward or higher in T9 and while as a summoner i think we have more leeway (and also it feeling a bit hard to obtain in my experience based on my luck) getting away with even 6-7k on the low end is doable albeit more risky.

Third, as a suggestion, I'd switch from Bard to Benefactor as in my experience Appease just doesnt cut it and eventually youll get hit regardless, though the Sonets to buffs pets are nice. But Benefactor just gives your summons such a large stat increase you can truly FEEL the upgraded power using it in T9. Also will help with your raid and boss damage immensely innately without having to worry about applying buffs.

Fourth, some orn earning suggestions are doing towers and trying to get as high as possible in the floors as the one time achievement payouts get upwards of millions. This takes some luck and trial and error of knowing what floor fights you can and cant take in the tower, as dying is much like any other instanced key run in Orna youre kicked out of it and it goes on cooldown, but with enough attempts you might be able to reach high 20s out of 40 something. I apologize for not being as detailed on this but i truly dont remember it well enough off the top of my head as ive just barely got into it myself.

Another suggestion for orns is doing Diluted Memories, hopefully you can find an hour where you dont need to move and then do as many as you can from there. Usually i never use more than one within an hour until i see that its couchable. There are ways to scale your rewards such as using Remembrance amenities that boost memory gains, the Elysian pets from one of the guilds (you must have access to its level 1 beastial bond for this which you can get by using an amenity or some class in the Valhallan line), and theres like some offhand item but i cant remember.  Ideally you have 2 Remembrance amenities that boost memory hunt gains, you put the Oracle specialization on a Valhallan class to let you use two amenities and have access to your followers level 1 bond, then use the Elysian follower for their boost. I only have one Remembrance at 75% and with the pet get upwards of 130k orns per memory hunt step, though low end can still be like 40k

Lastly there is a summoner guide with a wide slew of information on builds, summons, items to look our for, etc. Truly a treasure trove of info, but dont be discouraged or hard stuck on following it to a T, especially the builds section, because you sometimes just dont got the stuff.

Edit: [Here](https://docs.google.com/document/u/0/d/1aA4za2mOqvx1AosEIf9JmztPSTr5wh5wmfiaraL_YYw/mobilebasic?pli=1) is the link to a google doc with a slew of different guides, the summoner one being present, but have a look at your leisure. Much of the top class related stuff is t10 related so as summoners we have it good with a more thorough t8-t10 guide.

author: seafish4712
body:
Completing the tower achievements climbing floors will get you pretty much all the orns you need to unlock all the classes. 
Mage class is really good for it if you already have him as T8-T9 and good gear for survivability/magic, for AOE I used Legendary Trevelyans staff and maxed on magic adorns for my gear. 
Any immortal gear you can get will be really good, and if you can get your hands on an ornate balor shield they'll have close to like +100% ward. If you're trying to run summon class Buggane summon puts in mad work as well and better to change to a summon based spec like Benefactor, some people will judge me for this but I ran Summoner as a Maji for awhile just for the mana reduction.

author: arusinoff
body:
If you are killing T8-T9 raid boss in solo in 20-30min - it's completely fine. As other classes it will take days or weeks with same gear you have :)))

At this point you just need to switch to Benefecator spec.
And since you will have even less hp, you will need to focus on your protection and survivability. 

Get ornate or at least legendary gear with Ward + hp, upgrade it to lvl 8-9. - check summoner spreadsheet for bis/available gear for you.

Same with summons. Buggane is a must. 

To get Orns - do the memories. Especially when you will get amity with bonus to memory rewards. When you will get 2 amities with bonus (+50-100%) - consider switching to Oracle spec for memory hunts, so you can equip 2 amities with bonus. Get like 100 mnemonics first, switch to Oracle and do them all.

Sometimes, with good distance gear/buffs, you can do memories without even moving - making ~250k Orns per 3-5 minutes.
